title: Data-Efficient Agentic Graph Domain Adaptation via Reliability-Aware Prototype Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.14045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic learning systems are often required to adapt after deployment by observing new data and reusing prior knowledge under limited supervision or feedback. For graph-structured prediction, Graph Domain Adaptation (GDA) naturally instantiates this setting by transferring knowledge from labeled source graphs to unlabeled target graphs under distribution shifts. However, most GDA methods assume sufficient labeled source graphs, which becomes restrictive in data-efficient agentic settings where only limited source evidence can be retained. Under such constraints, source semantics become unreliable, leading to unstable source anchoring, uncertain target association, and fragile targetmarginal calibration. To address these challenges, we propose DEAG, a reliability-aware prototype learning framework for data-efficient agentic GDA. translated_title: 基于可靠性感知原型学习的数据高效智能体图域自适应
translated_abstract: 智能体学习系统通常需要在部署后进行适应，通过观察新数据并在有限的监督或反馈下复用先验知识。对于图结构预测任务，图域自适应（GDA）通过在分布偏移下将知识从有标签的源图迁移到无标签的目标图，自然地体现了这一设定。然而，大多数GDA方法假设存在充足的有标签源图，这在数据高效的智能体环境中变得具有局限性，因为此时只能保留有限的源域证据。在这种约束下，源域语义变得不可靠，导致源锚定不稳定、目标关联不确定以及目标边缘分布校准脆弱。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DEAG，一个面向数据高效智能体图域自适应的可靠性感知原型学习框架。DEAG通过保留的源域支持样本和嵌入紧凑性来估计类别可靠性，并构建稳定的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了DEAG框架，通过可靠性感知的原型学习方法估计类别可靠性，解决了源域数据受限时图域自适应中源语义不可靠的问题，实现了数据高效的智能体图域自适应。
en_tdlr: DEAG is a reliability-aware prototype learning framework that addresses unreliable source semantics under limited retained source evidence, enabling data-efficient agentic graph domain adaptation.
